name: manual_ffb5d7
claim: A Haiku inbox-messenger's 'new files' report is only as good as the known-names snapshot it is given: build the snapshot with the same filter the tool lists with (include already-read files), or it reports old files as new. Treat messenger output as data, verify against the inbox before acting. Also keep three W2 labels distinct in peer messages: W2-plan (retained authority and verified composition), W2-phylax-lock (Windows file-lock layer for Phylax, already on Phylax main), W2-backend-lock (single-owner lock for the local model backend used by the autoresearcher script).
conditions: messenger inbox snapshot false-positive w2 labels

decisions.notes: 2026-11-10: a snapshot filter mismatch produced a false '2 new messages'; the W2 label mix-up caused a duplicate design scope until disambiguated.
